Similarly, ████████████, who arrived at G/F at about 1520 hours using lift L15, failed to exit the lift at G/F due to blockage of the exit by burning bamboo scaffoldings. █ peeked out from the lift but was too afraid to escape through the fire, as shown in Photo 12. █ chose to retreat into the lift and went upwards. Unfortunately, the tenability of the lift lobbies on upper floors deteriorated so quickly, as mentioned in paragraph 30, resulting in the loss of █ life.

6 Although the CCTV footage was time-stamped at 1518 hours, it was approximately 2 minutes behind the HKO reference time, making the actual time approximately 1520 hours.
